ui.name: query
ui.label: Query
ui.help: A LogsQL query ending in a [stats pipe](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/logsql/#stats-pipe), e.g. `* | stats by (service.name) count() logs`. The tile's timeframe is applied automatically. Two shortcuts are available: `| normalize_severity` adds a `severity` field (critical, error, warning, info, debug or unknown) from the log's severity fields, OpenTelemetry severity number or message, and `| normalize_k8s` adds `cluster`, `namespace`, `pod` and `container` fields from whichever Kubernetes field convention the log uses.

ui.name: scope
ui.label: Objects (optional)
ui.help: Only include logs from the selected objects. Leave empty to search all logs.

ui.name: step
ui.label: Step (optional)
ui.help: Bucket size of range queries. Defaults to about 120 buckets across the timeframe.

ui.name: pivot
ui.label: Pivot field (optional)
ui.help: Turn the values of this field into columns: results that differ only by this field become one row, with a column per value. Use `__name__` to give each stats result its own column, e.g. `* | stats by (service.name) count() logs, count() if (level:error) errors` with pivot `__name__` gives one row per service with `logs` and `errors` columns.
